Fixtures recorded 2026-11-05 using `xcrun devicectl list devices` and `xcrun devicectl device info lockState`. The list fixture retains the two configured physical phones and only parser-relevant fields; all identifiers are placeholders. Both phones returned `passcodeRequired=false` and `unlockedSinceBoot=true`. The unlocked fixture is a scrubbed live response from the first phone. The locked fixture is explicitly derived from that response by setting `passcodeRequired=true`; no locked live capture was obtained. The sibling profile.plist is entirely made up. Raw diagnostics remain in ignored build scratch, outside results.
